title: Shipping Paraffin Blocks to the Bodenmiller Lab for IMC Analysis
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf5njq5e

steps.title: Create Shipping Label
steps.instruction: Generate a FedEx Priority Overnight shipping label for the Bodenmiller Lab.

substeps.instruction: Go to the FedEx website and select Priority Overnight Shipping.
Enter the address: Stefanie Engler, Winterthurestrasse 190, Bodenmiller Lab, Y11-J80, Zurich, CH8057, 41446356630.

steps.title: Prepare Customs Invoice
steps.instruction: Create a customs invoice for international shipping using the provided FedEx Customs Invoice.doc template.

steps.title: Package Paraffin Blocks
steps.instruction: Securely pack the paraffin blocks in a small box suitable for a FedEx label.

substeps.instruction: Wrap each paraffin block separately with protective wrapping.
Include paperwork identifying the block numbers for all blocks being shipped.
Fill empty space in the box to secure blocks in place.
Seal the box with shipping tape.

steps.title: Label and Ship Package
steps.instruction: Attach documentation and dispatch the package via FedEx.

substeps.instruction: Place the customs invoice underneath the shipping label, ensuring the shipping label barcode faces out.
Deposit the sealed box into a FedEx station.
